- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:grep -EiP "((Closes|Fixes|Resolves):?\s+([#]|https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/))\K[0-9]+" | severity= | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Lack of a trailing word boundary or digit-termination anchor can extract a partial issue ID from malformed text.
  WHY: If a PR body contains a keyword followed by an issue ID that is immediately followed by non-digit characters, the regex can extract a partial ID and process the wrong issue.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:grep -EiP ... | severity= | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Dependence on head -n 1 makes smoke-test detection order-dependent when multiple closing keywords are present.
  WHY: If multiple closing keywords are present, only the first is taken, so the smoke-test logic may miss the intended issue.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:grep -EiP "((Closes|Fixes|Resolves):?\s+([#]|https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/))\K[0-9]+" | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Lack of a trailing word boundary or digit-termination anchor.
  WHY: If a PR body contains a keyword followed by an issue ID that is Immediately followed by non-digit characters (e.g. `Closes #1234v2`), the regex will extract `1234` and attempt to process it as a smoke test issue, potentially leading to a 404 or incorrect configuration if issue 1234 exists but is not the intended target.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:grep -EiP ... | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Dependence on head -n 1 without ensuring valid issue context.
  WHY: If multiple closing keywords are present, only the first is taken. If the first one cited is a regular bug fix but the second one is the smoke test, the smoke test logic will not activate. While technically a limitation rather than a bug, it makes the smoke-test detection order-dependent in the PR description.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
